shortDescription: Get the Current Information of a WTI device

options.name: cpm_enddate
options.description: End date of the range to look for current data

options.name: cpm_password
options.description: This is the Password of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: cpm_startdate
options.description: Start date of the range to look for current data

options.name: cpm_url
options.description: This is the URL of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: cpm_username
options.description: This is the Username of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: use_https
options.description: Designates to use an https connection or http connection.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: Flag to control if the lookup will observe HTTP proxy environment variables when present.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If false, SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
